expectedIssues: Middle card in the carousel is not aligned with the other cards
reportedIssues: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card sits about 28px lower than its neighbors. Its image top, time badge, title and delivery fee are all offset compared with 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccola', so the row looks jagged.

The favorite (heart) buttons look inconsistent. On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card the heart has no background, while on the pizza card below it sits inside a dark translucent circle. This also lowers the ramen heart's contrast against busy imagery.
